summary: Brand new (<100 followers). Bio violates rules: niche/region targeting, timeframe claim, permanent free offer. Reels lose 77% in 3s — hooks fail. Lead_gen outperforms; question/comparison hooks hint best. Too little data for confidence.
guidance:
- Rotate to **question** or **comparison** hooks (contrast underperforms at 0.31x).
- Avoid repeating "4 hours vs 4 minutes" framing — used 3× recently.
- Posts must read as a developer showing real work, never an ad.
- Use bright-desk image style (1.53x hint).
- Keep examples broad: mention 2–3 varied business types max per line.

instructions.research: List 5 common website mistakes Indian small businesses make (any industry) that stop customers from messaging.
instructions.analysis: Compare the two recent website posts (10/31 comparison, 11/7 contrast) — note which hook style got more saves/shares.
instructions.writer: Write a question-hook carousel: "What does a customer check on your site before they WhatsApp you?" Cover 3 universal checks. End with pay-after-approval + DM offer.
instructions.image: Create a bright-desk carousel slide: code editor showing a clean contact section, no niche branding.
instructions.video: Skip video today — static carousel fits website service better.

manual_tips: Rewrite Instagram bio: remove niches, region, timeframe, and permanent free offer. Keep only: "Websites for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM for a quick 3-point site check."
Comment on 5 posts from Indian small business owners (varied industries) about their online presence — ask genuine questions, don't pitch.
